2. SCOPE OF WORK EXECUTED
Water Treatment works for Mahanadi Steel Corporation completed 2022.
The work was carried out under site conditions that included expansive clay in
the sub-grade requiring additional treatment. The agency organised its resources
around this without recourse to the department for additional assistance, and
the programme was re-sequenced locally to keep the critical path intact.
An extension of time was granted during execution on account of delayed handover
of the site frontage by the local authority. The delay was examined by this
office and held to be beyond the agency's control; no compensation was claimed
and none has been paid.
The above work was executed under the supervision of the undersigned in
accordance with the approved drawings, specifications, and the terms and
conditions of the contract. The work has been completed in all respects and has
been got inspected by the Engineer-in-Chief / Superintending Engineer.
3. QUALITY ASSESSMENT
The overall quality of the completed work is graded Very Good. Workmanship was
good, with finishing standards above the specified norm, and final inspection

5. DEFICIENCY / OBSERVATION LIST
At the time of taking over, surface regularity re-tested and accepted on the
second attempt. Regarding site safety, no lost-time injury was reported over the
contract period. The agency's conduct during the contract is recorded as
responsive throughout the defect liability period.
Nil. No major deficiencies observed during the final inspection carried out on
2022-08-28. All minor observations pointed out during the interim inspections
have been rectified to the satisfaction of the inspecting authority.
6. RECOMMENDATION
Having satisfied myself as to the quantity and quality of the work executed, and
on the basis of the joint measurements recorded in the measurement book, I
certify the work complete and recommend release of the balance payment together
with the retention money due on expiry of the defect liability period. Certified
by S. Chaudhary, Superintending Engineer.
The work has been completed in all respects as per the approved drawings,
specifications, and contract conditions. The quality of work has been found
satisfactory during the final inspection carried out by the undersigned.
This certificate is issued for the sole purpose of recording completion of the above work and does
not absolve the contractor of any obligations under the contract, including the defect liability
period.
